written.title: ‘Vice City’ Trademark Abandoned by WWE ahead of GTA 6 launch
written.description: What IGN, GamesRadar+, Kotaku, Push Square and Rockstar Newswire reported about Vice City and Jason Duval, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Vice City, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## IGN, 23 September 2026

[‘Vice City’ Trademark Abandoned by WWE ahead of GTA 6 launch](https://www.ign.com/articles/vice-city-trademark-abandoned-by-wwe-ahead-of-gta-6-launch)

The outlet's own summary:

> With GTA 6 imminent, it appears that WWE was trying to trademark the term ‘Vice City,’ before abandoning plans to do so.

> Incidentally, backyard wrestling looks set to be one of the many, many activities available for Jason and Lucia to engage with in GTA 6, with even a nod to John Cena’s Attitude Adjustment finisher spotted in the recent extended look at the game.

> By Simon Cardy Updated : Sep 23, 2026 11:33am UTC 5 comments Add IGN on Google It appears that WWE was trying to trademark the term ‘Vice City,’ before abandoning plans to do so.

> It’s not just her in-ring name that suggests this was the case either, but also the fact that she is from Miami, Florida, the real-life location GTA’s Vice City is based on.

> Vice City is, of course, the setting of the PS2 classic GTA Vice City and the upcoming GTA 6.

> The extent to which Rockstar is reminding people of this can be seen in real-life Miami now, with nearly $1 million spent on ‘Welcome to Vice City’ signage .

## GamesRadar+, 24 September 2026

[GTA 6 Collector's Box is $400 and doesn't include the game, but you do get a spoon, stickers, and more needlessly expensive merch](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-collectors-box-is-usd400-and-doesnt-include-the-game-but-you-do-get-a-spoon-stickers-and-more-needlessly-expensive-merch/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar's even throwing in a pair of Oakleys

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> Spoons aside, if you just want to nab your copy of the game, GTA 6 pre-orders are still going strong across the web: US: $79.99 at Amazon UK: £67.95 at Amazon To be frank, I think we've different definitions of that last part, but how and ever.

> The Grand Theft Auto 6: The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection was just revealed by Rockstar , a merch capsule you can now pre-order from the official store.

> Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look - YouTube Watch On Everything comes emblazoned in some sort of logo, whether for Vice City or GTA 6 itself or Rockstar, and you can get the whole lot for $399.99, or £349.99 in Britain.

## GamesRadar+, 24 September 2026

[GTA 6's $400 collectible spoon is actually a reference to another, far more expensive GTA spoon from 18 years ago](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6s-usd400-collectible-spoon-is-actually-a-reference-to-another-far-more-expensive-gta-spoon-from-18-years-ago/)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar's been in the cutlery game for a minute

> Decidedly appropriate for anyone preparing to jaunt around Leonida for hours and hours.

> The contents include a double-sided poster, a statue of Macca the Gator, and the greatest prize of all, a Vice City-emblazoned spoon.

## IGN, 24 September 2026

[GTA 6 Is Getting a $400 Collector's Set Filled With Tons of Merch, but No Game](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-is-getting-a-400-collectors-set-that-doesnt-include-the-game)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 is getting a $400 collector's set filled with Vice City-themed goodies, but it won't include a copy of the game.

> By Cade Onder Updated : Sep 24, 2026 3:58pm UTC 95 comments Add IGN on Google GTA 6 is getting a $400 collector's set filled with Vice City-themed goodies, but it won't include a copy of the game.

> Rockstar Games has announced a collector's set for GTA 6 known as GTA 6: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection.

> Rockstar also recently installed a massive "Welcome to Vice City" sign in on the Miami Heat's arena in Florida, which reportedly cost the company nearly $1 million .

## Kotaku, 24 September 2026

[Fans React To GTA 6's $400 Collector's Box That Doesn't Include The Game: 'We Wanted Jason And Lucia, And We Got An Alligator Instead'](https://kotaku.com/fans-reacts-to-gta-6s-400-collectors-box-that-doesnt-include-the-game-we-wanted-jason-and-lucia-and-we-got-an-alligator-instead-2000737007)

The outlet's own summary:

> For many fans, this isn't the big box of GTA stuff they wanted and the price isn't winning them over

> A lot of fans wanted a Jason and Lucia statue or goodies more directly related to GTA 6 and the franchise, not cartoon characters from a fake show.

> On Thursday, Rockstar opened up pre-orders for “ Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection” box .

> This includes a pink alligator statue, enamel pins themed around characters from the in-universe cartoon, and a double-sided poster featuring a map of Vice City and characters from the show.

## Push Square, 24 September 2026

[GTA 6 Collector's Box Is $400, Doesn't Include the Game](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/09/gta-6-collectors-box-is-usd400-doesnt-include-the-game)

The outlet's own summary:

> It's sort of like a Collector's Edition

> If you're in the UK (actually they deliver globally) Super Rare games are selling a physical version of Dying Light The Beast, but you got untill Oct 16.

> 14 2 8th_Observer 4 hours ago I would love see what the “cost to produce” is for this… 14 3 kungfumongoose 4 hours ago All that crap and no game and they want 400 for it? gtfo.

> 0 15 GirlVersusGame 4 hours ago I want literally nothing in that set.

> I don't mind taking the bait and buying this crap for very specific massive games but you better give me good crap if you want $300+.

> Next time you want to post about 'disc bad' just refrain from posting/talking...at all.

> If I offered the seller 350 quid for it, they'd smack me round the face for taking the mickey out of them 0 77 VenomUK 39 mins ago This is the king of tat in a box made for people who are so excited about GTAVI they want to pay money to show it!

> Here's how Rockstar pitches the expensive item: "A premium Collector’s Box featuring all the essentials for a good time, inspired by Leonida’s hit TV show, Macca the Gator." It's due to release on the same day as the PS5 title, 19th November 2026.

> Oakley Frogskins Sunglasses Block out the Leonida sun with a pair of matte black Oakley® Frogskins™ sunglasses, featuring Prizm Sapphire lenses and a Vice City pink GTAVI logo.

> Leonida Keys Crossbody Bag Stow all your essentials in a ripstop crossbody bag with patterned black and pink lining, woven patches, and a custom debossed YKK zipper pull.

> New Era 9FORTY Snapback Hat Look like a local in a New Era® 9FORTY A-Frame snapback hat with Vice City Leonida embellishments, embroidery, and appliques.

> Leonida Keys Enamel Pin Set in Metal Tin Add Vice City flair anywhere with nine enamel pins in a custom tin.

> Leonida Keys Sticker Pack in Stash Bag Slap a little Leonida on laptops, water bottles, and anywhere else your heart desires with nine crack-and-peel vinyl stickers in a stash bag.

> Double-Sided Poster with Map of Leonida An illustrated Vice City Leonida poster featuring characters from the hit Leonida TV show Macca the Gator on the front.

> Plan a road trip to every corner of the Goodtime State with a full view of the Leonida map featured on the back.

> Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6 Collector's Box Is $400, Doesn't Include the Game It's sort of like a Collector's Edition by Liam Croft 4 hours ago Share: Rockstar has today unveiled GTA 6 : The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection , which is sort of like a Collector's Edition.

> Vice City Collectible Swizzle Spoon Stir things up with a decorative spoon featuring a debossed enamel Vice City logo and a Rockstar Games logo tip.

> Vice City Razor Blade Keychain Stay sharp with a metallic razor-blade-style keychain featuring embossed GTAVI and Vice City logos.

> 7 18 TDHorizon 4 hours ago @JLSlone I'm glad that amongst the rubble, at least one sane view always manage to stand out 1 19 TDHorizon 4 hours ago RDR2 fully sealed collector's boxes currently selling between £700 and £1000 on ebay in the last few months.

## Rockstar Newswire, 24 September 2026

[Pre-Order The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection Now While Supplies Last - Rockstar Games](https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/9k2a49ook82o57/pre-order-the-goodtime-state-vice-city-collection-now-while-supplies-l)

The outlet's own summary:

> Introducing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a premium Grand Theft Auto VI collectible set featuring all the essentials for a good time, inspired by Leonida’s hit TV show, Macca the Gator.

> Please note that if you turn off some types of Cookies, it may limit your experience on the Site and the services we are able to offer.

> Pre-order The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection now at store.rockstargames.com , and look out for the arrival of more apparel and collectibles from the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection at the Rockstar Store soon.

> Stay tuned for details on how to pre-order The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection across Asia, Latin America, and Australia.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
